folds.text: Claude comes in a family of models. From lightest to most capable: {{facts.models}}. Each is a different trade of speed, depth and usage.
**Haiku** is the fastest and lightest. **Sonnet** is the best mix of speed and smarts, a good default for most jobs.
**Opus** suits long coding and knowledge work. **Fable** is for the hardest reasoning and long multi-step jobs. Bigger models usually use more of your allowance.
**Effort** is how hard Claude thinks before it answers. Higher effort helps on tricky problems, but takes longer and uses more. Simple jobs do not need it.

folds.prompt: Which model fits the job? Tap the basket.

items.text: Sort a pile of messages into groups, fast
items.why: Quick, repetitive jobs suit the lightest model.

items.text: Summarise an article and tidy an email
Work through a big coding task over a long session
Untangle a very hard problem with many steps
items.why: Save the most capable model for the toughest jobs.
